changes.title: Challenge columns
items: The challenge circle has a column for every kind of animal on the island, and each column carries that kind's sigils while it still has wild ones standing, adult below and youth above, so you can see from the circle who's left to win over
Invite one, or see it off, and its sigil leaves its column; a column with none left lights up warm, and once every column is lit the music spell is ready

Islands with many kinds get a bigger circle, so the columns stay about 7.5 m apart: up to about 76 m round on a home that knows every kind, its 128-animal pack the ultimate challenge, and its area grows to hold the whole circle
Big fights with many animals waiting their turn run faster

changes.title: Cauldron layer
items: In the house the big cauldron (and any potion basket) now stands in front of the witch when she walks behind it, instead of her being drawn over it.
On the Terrace's far side, by the wardrobe and mirror, the witch no longer disappears: she was being hidden by her own see-through fade.

changes.title: No anchor hint
items: Removed the "too heavy to fly with" message that showed the first time an adult or legend held you on the ground

changes.title: Cooldown trail 2
items: Your whole trail is now dotted: the first band (as long as your speed makes it) is in your trail colours too, and each band behind it is a dodge still recharging. Only the first band left means every dodge, and taking off, is ready.
The trail now goes behind trees and scenery just as you do, and shows through with you where the canopy's cut away.
The trail's dots glow a little more, and the take-off ring is gone.

changes.title: Commanded feeding
items: Feeding is now up to you: no animal eats on its own. Stand within 15 m of a berry and tap the sigil button (E, square) to feed the animal at the bottom of your stack; each tap queues one more berry. The berry it'll go for is marked, with the prompt beside it
With a berry marked, hold the sigil button for a moment to put that animal's sigil down instead
A sigil in your stack twinkles the dot it's about to fill while it has a berry queued; babies now show their one berry dot
Knocked down, your animals' sigils fall where you went down and stay there: they wait for you there, parked, and guard the spot
